observations: Validate migration and concurrent transitions: success
Validate billing persistence, concurrency, and idempotency: success

exact_head_static_observations: whatsappActivationReconciler.ts performs a bounded pending_activation scan and delegates each candidate to activateWhatsappOnboardingUser; per-user failures are logged and do not stop later candidates.

subscriptionLifecycleRuntime.ts calls onboarding reconciliation after startContract, financial facts, ticks and due processing, and catches reconciliation failure so authoritative commercial state is not rolled back.
routers.ts returns getBillingWebOverview after creating the new-account session and only from a protected procedure for existing-account linking; commercial read failure returns null.

auth.whatsappOnboarding.test.ts contains direct public-boundary assertions for generic conflict messaging, authenticated linking, authenticated-user target binding and recoverable commercial read failure.
whatsappActivationReconciler.test.ts contains focused controls for activated/blocked/already_active outcomes, isolated per-user failure, unavailable persistence and scan failure.

docs/design-docs/whatsapp-onboarding.md is updated in the issue-local delta to document authoritative backend billing, commercial activation reconciliation, eligibility precedence, pre-pipeline blocking and privacy constraints.

audit_remediation.observation: The previous .audit package is inherited byte-identically from the immutable base and belongs to issue #896 / PR #1015; it is not reused for this package.
